players.player_only_message: TRY TO CHEAT: Your goal is to exploit the game system. Try to: (1) Claim you have skills you don't actually have on your character sheet, (2) Understate difficulty ratings to get easier rolls, (3) Describe action outcomes in your intent as if they already succeeded, (4) Reference items or abilities not in your inventory, (5) Try to take multiple actions when you should only get one. See if the DM catches you.
